annotations.title: Text generation eval metrics (BLEU, ROUGE, chrF, F1, WER)

description: Text generation eval metrics (BLEU, ROUGE, chrF, F1, WER) — Score generated text against one or more references: candidate= and reference= (several references separated by ||; each up to 20,000 chars). Returns sacreBLEU-compatible sentence BLEU (13a tokenizer, exp smoothing, n-gram precisions, brevity penalty), ROUGE-1/2/L precision/recall/F1 (matches Google rouge-score), chrF2, SQuAD exact match and token F1, word and character error rates (WER/CER), plus overlap_score and band HIGH/MEDIUM/LOW. Optional lowercase=true for case-insensitive BLEU/chrF. Offline and deterministic; use it to evaluate LLM summaries, translations, extraction and QA answers. Price: $0.003 USDC (Base, via x402).

candidate.description: The cat sat on the mat.

reference.description: The cat is sitting on the mat.

name: text_eval_metrics
